newsitem.title: UK: HSBC brings Tolkien into corporate finance team.
newsitem.headline: HSBC brings Tolkien into corporate finance team.

text.p: HSBC Investment Bank, part of the HSBC Group, said on Monday it had appointed Richard Tolkien as a managing director in its corporate finance and advisory division with effect from mid-January 1997.
Tolkein will have particular responsibility for international corporate finance, it said in a statement.
HSBC said Tolkien would join from Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, where he was global head of utilities. He joined Morgan Grenfell in 1982 after five years at the UK Treasury, it added.
